CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2619 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487. Bus nonce: a529b04404868c552ade79fbf6da5202. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487` or `Fix review: blocked abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: a529b04404868c552ade79fbf6da5202`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2619 abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2619-a529b044`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
REVIEW of roster PR #2619 (batch 14) at head abebbedcd4acf859f2313d63ac1b8c9520749487. Data-only roster change (dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json and dev/programme/delivery/2619.md). PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Spare the GitHub API (one check-runs read). Mirror the #2613 roster review.
Check:
1. Four ops: R10-YIELD-PROBE done at a9db4784 (#2579), R10-RELAY-HOLD done at 50808a75 (#2580), R10-PREPR-CAP done at f0724675 (#2528), R10-CURRENCY in-progress. Each SHA is on origin/main; each done group owes no further PR (no "PR 2/2" left in its carry).
2. No open PR body carries to a group set done.
3. The body's ops count equals the `git rev-list --count` over the stated range; group counts match, none removed unintentionally.
4. brief_lint TOTAL 0; carry_audit check --body 0 unrouted 0 bad; merge-tree with origin/main clean; no red check on the head, or the body's Red checks names it.
Return merge unless an item fails. Time box 30 min.
